title: Alfalfa
text: This remedy is a great fat producer and is indicated in cases of malnutrition and lack of appetite. It is useful in cases of anaemia and general debility. It increases the quantity and quality of milk in nursing mothers. There is a general feeling of well-being and improved digestion. Clear and bright. Improved memory. Depression and anxiety. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the occiput. Vertigo. Increased appetite. Thirst. Improved digestion. Distended with gas. Flatulence. Increased quantity of urine. Increased urea. Compare: China; Avena sativa; Hydrastis. Five to ten drops of the tincture.
